title: Tim V NDE 4375
content: I suddenly woke up in what I can only describe as an open space of light. I saw several human forms made of light. In the blink of an eye, two of these forms suddenly appeared on either side of me. When I looked at them from close up, I could see into their brilliance. I could see their features. One of them was my grandmother and the other was my dad. They were made of light. It was them but much younger and more perfect. My grandmother proceeded to welcome me home, not to worry we will take good care of you were her exact words. This was not speech; it was more like telepathy. I really can't describe the overwhelming feeling of peace, love, joy and RELIEF!!! I was finally back home. It was like my memory of this place was coming back. I knew so much there that I don't remember now. But I do remember feeling like I was away at school and I had finally come home. That place truly is my home and I can't wait to get back there. I did come back. I didn't want to. I felt an unseen force pull me away from them. I felt a jolt and I woke up in my body with my son shaking my arm and saying, 'I've got him, he's back.' My first thought was how limited my body was. I had to use eyes to see, ears to hear and a body to feel. It felt awful, not to mention I was very ill. I felt trapped in my body. As I was being pulled away from my dad and grandmother, one thought was in the forefront, 'Trust in God and pray.' My dad has been dead for twelve years and my grandmother thirty. I came away from this experience knowing that we're from there not here.

arrival.other_being_detail: Several human forms made of light; two were identified as his grandmother and his dad (both appearing younger and more perfect).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt an unseen force pull him away; then felt a jolt and woke up in his body.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: The experience begins with immediate arrival in an open space of light with beings (grandmother and dad), followed by an involuntary pull back and return to the body; no tunnel/OBE described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He described instantly 'waking up' in an open space of light and seeing multiple human forms made of light; he emphasized feeling his memory of that place coming back and that he 'knew so much there' but could not remember after returning.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “welcome me home, not to worry we will take good care of you” / “Trust in God and pray.” / “I came away from this experience knowing that we're from there not here.”
